desc: Combining the style of old world manufacturing and the efficiency of modern CNC machines Tokarev USA aims to bring quality firearms to the market. The TTF Field is one such firearm, this 12 Gauge Semi Auto shotgun is made with all the skill and craftsmanship as the original Tula plant. The shotgun uses a 28" Steel barrel. The barrel comes with a sight rib for bringing the fiber optic front sight to the shooter eye. The furniture is made with Polymer stock for that modern look with some added strength. This particular shotgun is set up to use Beretta/ Benelli chokes opening the options for aftermarket muzzle accessories. If you want a hunting shotgun made with an attention to detail and an old school reputation look for the Tokarev USA TTF Field Shotgun.
